title: Exoplanet Spectroscopy Research Lab
text: The university laboratory studies exoplanet atmosphere spectroscopy, telescope observations, planetary science, datasets, methods, results, references and publications. Research projects measure radius, orbit and atmospheric composition.

title: Abstract: Atmospheric Retrievals for Exoplanets
text: Abstract. This paper reports telescope spectroscopy methods, results and citation data for exoplanet atmosphere research. DOI and references are listed for review.

title: Lab Open House Event
text: Join students for a campus event with tours, photos and brief astronomy demonstrations.
